Mira (PM): Heads-up: i'm drafting a compact 'gating playbook' for tenant-islands (routing + multi-region isolation). need concrete, minimal acceptance criteria we can show customers.
Ethan (Eng): Love the playbook idea. Please make the runtime gates very specific: KV cache hit thresholds, max added hop ms, and a model-compatibility tag for cross-region fallbacks.
Zoe (Infra): From infra: placement modes (hard-pin / soft-prefer / no-preference), autoscale < 60s for 2x load, and an egress delta estimate customers can review. we'll need a scheduler webhook to enforce hard-pin.
Pri (SRE): Ops needs: canary cadence (0.5% for 24h -> 5% for 72h -> 25% for 7d), per-tenant error budget tracking, and an incident playbook that includes automatic rollback thresholds.
Ravi (Sales): Sales asks for two lanes on the playbook: Pilot (no SLA, low commit) and Reserved (SLA + credits). customers want a short migration window guarantee and a concierge offer for first reserved customers.
Marta (Legal): We'll prepare two contract snippets. Important: define "fallback" precisely (temporal vs permanent) and what qualifies as an "outage" triggering credits.
Mira (PM): Proposed gating table in the playbook: rows = Pilot/Canary/GA, columns = Customer acceptance, Infra gating, Runtime gating, SRE gating, Legal/billing. Each cell has pass/fail criteria.
Ethan (Eng): Runtime gating detail (Pilot): KV cache hit >= 80% steady state for pilot traffic, added hop median < 100ms, batching tail < target; compatibility tag present on deployed model artifacts.
Zoe (Infra): Infra gating detail (Pilot): scheduler honors soft-prefer, autoscale reacts within 60s to 2x burst, egress cost delta < +30% or explicit customer approval. We'll produce egress numbers for top 3 regions.
Pri (SRE): SRE gating detail (Pilot): telemetry shows token-level cost, per-tenant P95 heatmap, automatic rollback triggered if error budget burn rate > 2x baseline for 10m. Tabletop runbook validated.
Ravi (Sales): Customer acceptance (Pilot): successful run on golden queries, signed migration window, and rollback contact. Sales proposes 1-month pilot credit to offset initial instability.
Marta (Legal): Credits ok but cap them. Also add a migration notice clause: X hours notice for major cutover; for cross-region fallback include customer opt-in for temporary residency relaxation.
Ethan (Eng): Note: model variants must be semantically compatible. If region A uses Q4 quantized variant and region B uses FP16, we need either output normalization or a client-visible version header. Recommend API header x-rls-model-version.
Zoe (Infra): We'll implement placement labels + a min-reserved-commit guardrail: reserved lane requires minimum GPU commit to reduce fragmentation. Also will add a placement enforcement webhook.
Pri (SRE): Recovery flow: 1) route to local fallback model, 2) if still unhealthy route to alternate region (flag as fallback), 3) mark tenant impacted after grace period (default 10m). SLA credits calculation documented.
Mira (PM): Operational checklist items for playbook: owners + ETA: - Ethan: runtime compatibility matrix + replay tests (2w) - Zoe: scheduler webhook + egress projections (2w) - Pri: canary runbook + dashboards (1w) - Ravi/Marta: pilot contract blurb + concierge offer scope (1w)
InfraBot: ticket created PLAT-7312 "tenant-islands-gating-playbook" assigned to Mira. Weekly sync Tue 10:00.
Ravi (Sales): For Concierge: Sales wants a 4-week window of hands-on cutover help for first 3 reserved customers. Marta, will that be ok liability-wise?
Marta (Legal): Concierge is fine with a timeboxed scope and cap. i'll author a short exhibit that limits scope to onboarding/config and excludes application-level data issues.
Ethan (Eng): I'll include a short doc explaining tradeoffs: latency-first (smaller batches, higher cost) vs cost-first (larger batching, potential p95 tail). Need sign-off from customer on which knob we use for their lane.
Zoe (Infra): I'll also add a 'traffic-surge' test we can run during pilot to validate autoscaler and KV priming under churn. will schedule as part of canary.
Pri (SRE): I'll draft concrete alert thresholds and an automated rollback policy for the playbook. will include a small simulation harness.
Mira (PM): please post final 1-paragraph owner plan in this thread by Thu so i can fold into the playbook. i'll share draft with GTM after that. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
Pri (SRE): :thumbsup:
Ethan (Eng): posting plan tomorrow.
Zoe (Infra): will do.
Ravi (Sales): will get a draft of the concierge offer to Marta.
Marta (Legal): will drop contract snippets in drive and ping for review.
InfraBot: reminder: follow-up sync scheduled Tue 10:00.
